summary.headline: Zydus Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 22% YoY to ₹80.2 billion with EBITDA margin of 24.1%; FY27 guidance held.
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue of ₹80.2 billion grew 22% YoY, with EBITDA of ₹19.3 billion (24.1% margin) and net profit of ₹9.4 billion; net debt/EBITDA was 0.7x at June 30, 2026. India branded formulations grew 20% YoY, international formulations grew 34% to ₹9.7 billion, and North America was ₹31 billion (up 5% QoQ). Management kept FY27 guidance of strong double-digit revenue growth and 24%+ EBITDA margin, with cost increases from acquisitions (Assertio, Zylidac) and Saroglitazar US launch prep flagged for the second half.

financial_highlights.change: Ahead of market; outperformed market for three consecutive years

financial_highlights.metric: Chronic and sub-chronic share (India, AWACS MAT June 2026)

segments.name: India formulations
segments.commentary: Branded business grew 20% YoY, ahead of market across super-specialty, chronic and acute; chronic portfolio growing above 20%, Saro and Desi growing 30-45%, biologics brands scaling post-genericisation. Management guides India at mid-teens growth, 300-500 bps above market.

segments.name: International formulations
segments.commentary: Revenue of ₹9.7 billion (+34% YoY), crossing $100 million per an analyst's comment; growth from core emerging markets, France and Spain, and new UK entry. Management expects strong double-digit growth to continue.

segments.name: North America (US and Canada)
segments.commentary: Revenue ₹31 billion, up 5% QoQ. US generics filed 5 ANDAs, received 9 approvals (4 tentative), launched 11 products; Canada 2 approvals and 2 launches. Management guides US growth around single digit for the year.

segments.name: US specialty and branded
segments.commentary: Branded business is about 10% of US revenue, with Sentynl (ultra-rare) around $60 million last year. Assertio acquisition completed, contributing from next quarter at about $15-20 million per quarter run rate; Nufymco (Ranibizumab) biosimilar launched in US.

segments.name: Consumer Wellness
segments.commentary: Revenue ₹14.3 billion (+67% YoY); international including Comfort Click grew 25% LFL, domestic grew 5% with skin and hair care +35% and food and nutrition +16%, seasonal brands declined on a soft summer. Management guides double-digit growth for the segment.

segments.name: Medical devices
segments.commentary: Revenue ₹2.8 billion; focus on orthopedics (Amplitude portfolio, Andy robotic surgical system), cardiology and nephrology, including a planned high-end dialyzer membrane facility.

guidance_outlook: FY27 guidance maintained: strong double-digit revenue growth; India mid-teens, international and US around single digit per management (US single-digit cited in response to a question).
EBITDA margin guidance of 24%+ maintained for FY27, assuming Saroglitazar investment ramps in H2 FY27.
Other expenses run-rate of about ₹1,900-2,000 crore per quarter, all-inclusive of Saro costs, excluding R&D.
FY27 capex guided at about ₹1,500-1,600 crore.
Saroglitazar US launch targeted for FY28 (April 2028); first two years mainly investment, meaningful revenue from years two and three.
Long-term EBITDA margin ambition of 28-30% as branded share moves toward two-thirds of revenue over roughly five years.
US launches planned for FY27: 30-40, at least 30+ including specialty.
Vaccines revenue target of ₹300-400 crore on track.
capex_capacity: FY27 capex guided at ₹1,500-1,600 crore; Q1 capex rose sharply, driven by SEZ 3 facility, expansions at Moraiya, Goa, Baddi and SEZ Units 2 and 3, a new formulations R&D centre, a CAR-T facility for biologics, a new vaccines DS facility, Zylidac investments, and a one-time wellness land acquisition.
Injectable facility at Zydus Biotech Park received an EIR with VAI classification after GMP inspections in April and May 2026.
Joint venture with Sunshine Healthcare signed to build a pharmaceutical manufacturing facility in Sri Lanka.
High-end dialyzer membrane facility planned for medtech nephrology.
demand_pricing: India branded growth of 20% driven by chronic portfolio, innovation brands (Lipaglyn), biosimilars and vaccines scaling; semaglutide is a small contributor to growth per management.
Aflibercept biosimilar launched in India (first mover) with good early traction per management.
Desidustat approved in China; NRDL reimbursement needed for major share; management expects a couple of quarters before more visibility. Competitor molecule reportedly at $200+ million in China.
Saroglitazar US peak sales view of $200-300 million (conservative) and $400+ million (optimistic); competitors upgraded guidance, indicating a larger market.
Mirabegron remains a profitable semi-exclusive product despite royalty and settlement costs that weigh on gross margin.

qa_highlights.question: Is Q1 strong topline growth implying growth above the FY27 double-digit guidance?
qa_highlights.answer: Management kept the guidance of strong double-digit growth for the year; India expected mid-teens growth, 300-500 bps above market, with international and US around single digit.

qa_highlights.question: How will opex (employee, SG&A) rise with Assertio and Saro, and is the 24%+ margin still intact?
qa_highlights.answer: Saro costs have started, with a meaningful increase in H2; 24% margin guidance maintained. Other expenses run-rate of ₹1,900-2,000 crore per quarter, all-inclusive. Management said about 80% of the increase is acquisition-driven (Zylidac, Assertio) plus freight.

qa_highlights.question: Capex color and full-year number?
qa_highlights.answer: FY27 capex guided at ₹1,500-1,600 crore, spread across multiple capacity and R&D projects plus a one-time wellness land purchase.

qa_highlights.question: Saro ramp and peak sales?
qa_highlights.answer: Launch in April 2028 (FY28); first two years are investment-led; conservative peak $200-300 million, optimistic $400+ million.

qa_highlights.question: US branded revenue composition and Assertio contribution?
qa_highlights.answer: Branded is about 10% of US revenue; Sentynl about $60 million last year (ultra-rare); the rest is 505(b)(2) products; Assertio adds from next quarter at $15-20 million per quarter run rate.

qa_highlights.question: Gross margin dip QoQ and YoY: is Mirabegron the reason and will it normalise in H2?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO attributed it to higher Mirabegron settlement/licensing costs under the Innovator arrangement. CEO said Mirabegron is profitable and semi-exclusive, and guidance still assumes 24% EBITDA margin.

risks_watch: Saro launch investment in H2 FY27 and FY28 could compress margins against the 24%+ guidance.
US generics pricing and Mirabegron royalty/settlement costs weigh on gross margin; monitor whether they normalise.
Slower-than-expected uptake of 505(b)(2) product BEIZRAY; monitor scale-up in FY28.
Desidustat China ramp depends on NRDL reimbursement, expected in 2-3 quarters.
Amortisation from acquisitions (Assertio purchase price allocation within 12 months) and Mirabegron licensing amortisation until Q2 FY28 will keep depreciation and amortisation elevated.
ALS (Usnoflast) phase 2b data expected FY28 end or early FY29; US biosimilar scale-up expected in calendar 2029.
Injectable facility VAI classification at Zydus Biotech Park could affect injectable supply and US approvals.
summary.management_tone: Confident on India and the innovation pipeline, with consistent reiteration of FY27 guidance. Evasive on Desidustat China sizing and on Saro peak sales in the near term, and declined to split biologics, innovation and vaccine revenue or disclose the Mirabegron amortisation figure.
key_quotes: We remain fully confident in our ability to outpace the industry growth and growing sustainably.
So, right now, we are guiding for around ₹1,500-₹1,600 crores capex.
Mirabegron is a very good profitable driver. So, it is not a negative to the business.

adds.what: Injectable facility at Zydus Biotech Park (received EIR with VAI classification)
Joint venture with Sunshine Healthcare to build pharmaceutical manufacturing facility in Sri Lanka
High-end dialyzer membrane facility for medtech nephrology
Expansions at SEZ 3, Moraiya, Goa, Baddi, SEZ Units 2 and 3, new vaccines DS facility, CAR-T facility (FY27 capex ₹1,500-1,600 crore)

growth.why: Management held FY27 guidance of strong double-digit revenue growth (India mid-teens, US around single digit) and 24%+ EBITDA margin, backed by Assertio ($15-20m per quarter from next quarter), 30-40 US launches and FY27 capex of ₹1,500-1,600 crore, though no specific revenue capacity additions were quantified.
